title: Linear support of harmonic measure in recurrent planar triangulations
exact_target: Can almost all exit probability be concentrated on a nearly linear number of boundary circles along arbitrarily large scales, at least for unimodular triangulations or the UIPT?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10000081 (AMR-099-0081). CC BY 4.0.
Itai Benjamini, \emph{Random Planar Metrics}; original author manuscript preserved in Arquivo.pt capture of 31 December 2020, Section 3.3, harmonic-measure question and following qualification, p. 8.
